fusions.name: Anchor Point
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second draw, fires an arrow that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets. It always strikes critically.

fusions.name: Snap Release
fusions.desc: Looses a quick arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: After a 1-second steadying draw, increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mounting Tension
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
